title: RiskCalculation
description: RiskAgent/RiskSkill output. See SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 7. Every field must be computed, never estimated.

account_equity.description: user-supplied; no live broker-balance source in v1

risk_pct.description: as a fraction, e.g. 0.0075 = 0.75%. Hard ceiling 0.01 (1%).

invalidation_defined_and_distinct_from_s.description: price invalidation, thesis invalidation, and data invalidation per master spec section 21 are each considered

no_averaging_down.description: false = a violation was requested and refused

no_widened_stop.description: false = a violation was requested and refused

consecutive_losses.description: read from the last closed trades in trades/*.md

throttle_active.description: true after 2 consecutive losses per master spec section 20; recommend half-size or pause
